titles.title: BEDROCK Act
BEDROCK Act
Biomanufacturing Excellence, Domestic Resilience, Output, and Competitive Know-how Act

To direct the Secretary of Commerce to promote competitiveness in biomanufacturing in the United States, identify supply-chain and commercialization vulnerabilities relating to critical biomanufacturing inputs and domestic production capacity, improve transparency regarding Federal processes applicable to biomanufactured products, and for other purposes.

action.text: Referred to the House Committee on Energy and Commerce.
